cohort: Mothers with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and their neonates
finding: Maternal Apo-B/Apo-A1 and Apo-E levels were positively associated with NH, while TGs were inversely associated with NH in neonates of mothers with GDM.
mod_finding: The study found that caesarean delivery was a predictive factor for neonatal hypoglycemia in infants of mothers with gestational diabetes.
